versions.subject: Merge PR #5063 from @Neo23x0 - Add & Update rules related to the suspicious creation of ".rdp" files
versions.detection:
selection_extension:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.rdp'
selection_location:
    - TargetFilename|contains: '\AppData\Local\Packages\Microsoft.Outlook_' # New Outlook
    - TargetFilename|contains|all:
          - '\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Windows\'
          - '\Content.Outlook\'
condition: all of selection_*
